tagline.en: The Great Valley truck road, Tennessee to the Thousand Islands
tagline.zh: 大峡谷货运通道，自田纳西至千岛群岛

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 田纳西州丹德里奇附近，与 I-40 相接

end.en: The Canadian border at the Thousand Islands Bridge, Wellesley Island, New York
end.zh: 纽约州韦尔斯利岛，千岛大桥处的加拿大边境

en: I-81 runs up the Great Valley of the Appalachians — the Shenandoah Valley in Virginia, the Cumberland Valley in Pennsylvania — following the line of old US 11 the whole way. It is a mountain-flanked corridor with a long history as a through route, and the Interstate inherited that role completely.

What distinguishes it is freight. This is the inland alternative to I-95 for north–south trucking, and on much of its length the traffic mix is closer to that of a freight railway than a passenger highway. The terrain makes it worse: long grades slow loaded trucks, most of the road is two lanes each way, and a single blocked lane removes most of the capacity.
North of Scranton it changes. Through New York it becomes a quieter road serving Binghamton, Syracuse and Watertown, and it ends on a bridge over the St Lawrence at the Thousand Islands.
zh: I-81 沿阿巴拉契亚的大峡谷北上——在弗吉尼亚是谢南多厄河谷，在宾夕法尼亚是坎伯兰河谷——全程循着旧 US 11 的走向。这是一条两侧夹山的走廊，作为过境通道历史悠久，而州际公路完整地继承了这一角色。
它的特别之处在于货运。对南北向卡车运输而言，这是 I-95 的内陆替代线；在很长的路段上，其交通构成更接近一条货运铁路，而非客运公路。地形让情况更糟：长纵坡拖慢重载卡车，大部分路段双向各两车道，一条车道被堵就会吃掉大部分通行能力。
斯克兰顿以北，它换了模样。穿过纽约州时，它成为一条较为安静的道路，服务宾厄姆顿、锡拉丘兹与沃特敦，最终在千岛群岛跨越圣劳伦斯河的一座桥上结束。

en: Virginia has studied its own 325-mile section more closely than most states study any road, because the General Assembly ordered a corridor plan in 2018 to work out whether to toll it. The findings are the clearest published picture of what I-81 actually carries.

The road was designed for a truck share of fifteen percent. It now runs well above that on average and more than twice that on some segments. Virginia's section alone accounts for a large share of all Interstate truck mileage in the state, and the plan found that on certain segments, once grade and truck percentage are taken into account, one tractor-trailer occupies the road space of as many as four cars.

Crashes compound it. The corridor averages thousands a year, a quarter of them involving heavy trucks — the highest share of any Interstate in Virginia — and dozens take more than four hours to clear, with no reliable parallel route to divert onto.
zh: 弗吉尼亚州对本州这 325 英里路段的研究之细，超过多数州对任何一条道路的研究——因为州议会在 2018 年下令编制一份走廊规划，以判断是否应当收费。其结论是关于 I-81 实际承载什么的最清晰的公开图景。
这条路的设计卡车比例为百分之十五。如今平均值已明显高于此数，某些路段更超过两倍。仅弗吉尼亚州这一段，就占该州全部州际公路卡车行驶里程中的很大一部分；规划还发现，在某些路段，一旦计入纵坡与卡车比例，一辆牵引挂车所占的道路空间相当于多达四辆小客车。
事故让问题雪上加霜。该走廊每年事故数以千计，其中四分之一涉及重型卡车——比例为弗吉尼亚州所有州际公路之最——并有数十起清理时间超过四小时，而沿线没有可靠的平行道路可供分流。

en: Virginia's 2018 corridor plan priced the problem. It identified needs across the whole Virginia section well in excess of what the state could fund, then recommended a smaller targeted programme of widenings, interchange work, truck climbing lanes and incident-management measures — to be paid for, in the option the governor and legislature endorsed, largely by tolling heavy trucks.

In New York the money is going the other way. The elevated I-81 viaduct through downtown Syracuse, built in the 1950s through a predominantly Black neighbourhood, is being torn down rather than rebuilt. Through traffic will be routed onto the existing I-481 bypass, which takes the I-81 number, while the old alignment becomes a business loop feeding a street-level grid.

It is the largest transportation project ever undertaken in upstate New York, and the reasoning stated in the state's own announcements is explicitly about undoing the damage the viaduct did to the neighbourhoods it cut through.
zh: 弗吉尼亚州 2018 年的走廊规划给问题标了价。它在全州路段范围内识别出的需求，远超该州的出资能力；随后推荐了一套规模较小的定向工程计划——拓宽、互通改造、卡车爬坡车道与事故处置措施——按州长与议会认可的方案，主要由对重型卡车收费来支付。
在纽约州，钱的流向正好相反。穿过锡拉丘兹市中心的 I-81 高架桥，1950 年代修建时穿过了一片以黑人居民为主的社区，如今的做法是拆除而非重建。过境车流将改走既有的 I-481 绕城线，并由其接过 I-81 的编号；原有线位则成为一条商业支线，为一套平面街道网络供给车流。
这是纽约州北部有史以来规模最大的交通工程，而该州官方公告中陈述的理由，明确指向弥补当年高架桥对其穿过的社区所造成的损害。

label.zh: 锡拉丘兹高架桥替换工程

value.en: $2.25 billion for the I-81 Viaduct Project: demolition of the elevated highway, a community grid of surface streets, a new Business Loop 81 and reconstruction of parts of I-481 and I-690, over about six years of construction
value.zh: I-81 高架桥工程造价 22.5 亿美元：拆除高架公路、建设地面街道网络、新设 81 号商业支线，并改建 I-481 与 I-690 的部分路段，施工期约六年

figures.source: New York State Department of Transportation and Office of the Governor, Record of Decision announcement, 2022

label.zh: 弗吉尼亚走廊改善计划

value.en: More than $4.3 billion in identified needs along the 325 miles in Virginia, of which about $2.0 billion of targeted improvements was recommended for financing
value.zh: 弗吉尼亚州境内 325 英里沿线识别出的需求逾 43 亿美元，其中约 20 亿美元的定向改善工程被建议纳入融资

figures.source: Virginia Department of Transportation, I-81 Corridor Improvement Plan, 2018

why.en: No route-wide construction figure is published. I-81 was built by six states over roughly two decades and federal cost accounting was kept for the Interstate System as a whole.
why.zh: 未发布全线建设造价。I-81 由六个州历时约二十年建成，联邦造价核算是针对整个州际公路系统的。

value.en: 781.30 miles as listed in the route log; the longest state section is Virginia at 324.92 miles, followed by Pennsylvania at 232.74
value.zh: 路线名录所列为 781.30 英里；最长的州内路段是弗吉尼亚州 324.92 英里，其次为宾夕法尼亚州 232.74 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

value.en: About 48,000 vehicles a day averaged over the corridor, rising to almost 67,000 near Roanoke
value.zh: 全走廊平均约每日 48,000 辆，罗阿诺克附近接近 67,000 辆

trafficFigures.source: Virginia Department of Transportation, I-81 corridor final report, 2018

value.en: 18 percent of traffic on average and up to 33 percent on some sections, against a design assumption of 15 percent
value.zh: 平均占交通量的 18%，部分路段高达 33%，而设计假定为 15%

trafficFigures.source: Virginia Department of Transportation, I-81 corridor final report, 2018

value.en: 11.7 million trucks a year carrying $312 billion in goods; 42 percent of all Interstate truck vehicle-miles travelled in the state
value.zh: 每年 1,170 万辆次卡车，运载货值 3,120 亿美元；占全州州际公路卡车行驶里程的 42%

trafficFigures.source: Virginia Department of Transportation, I-81 Corridor Improvement Plan, 2018, using Transearch and VDOT data 2012–2016

label.zh: 弗吉尼亚走廊事故情况

value.en: More than 2,000 a year, 26 percent involving heavy trucks — the highest share of any Interstate in Virginia; more than 45 a year take over four hours to clear
value.zh: 每年逾 2,000 起，其中 26% 涉及重型卡车，比例为弗吉尼亚州所有州际公路之最；每年逾 45 起清理时间超过四小时

conditionFigures.source: Virginia Department of Transportation, I-81 Corridor Improvement Plan, 2018

value.en: Most of the Virginia corridor is two lanes in each direction; blocking one lane removes 65 percent of capacity
value.zh: 弗吉尼亚走廊大部分路段双向各两车道；封闭一条车道将减少 65% 的通行能力

conditionFigures.source: Virginia Department of Transportation, I-81 Corridor Improvement Plan, 2018

timeline.en: I-81 is numbered in the first plan for the Interstate System, following the US 11 corridor.
timeline.zh: 州际公路系统首个编号方案中，I-81 获得编号，循 US 11 走廊而行。

timeline.en: Virginia's General Assembly orders a corridor improvement plan, producing the fullest published account of what the road carries.
timeline.zh: 弗吉尼亚州议会下令编制走廊改善规划，形成了关于这条路承载状况的最完整公开记录。

timeline.en: New York signs the Record of Decision to replace the Syracuse viaduct with a community grid.
timeline.zh: 纽约州签署决定记录，以社区街道网络取代锡拉丘兹高架桥。

timeline.en: Construction begins on the Syracuse I-81 Viaduct Project.
timeline.zh: 锡拉丘兹 I-81 高架桥工程开工。
